usedFor: NetHunt CRM logs customer calls, and “New Call Logs” writes notes into a Google Docs tab.

bestTemplate.name: “New Call Logs” in NetHunt CRM, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new call log is added to a Google Docs tab, building a running record of calls.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs can replace a tab's content, so choose add.
